description: Les chantiers impactant la circulation sur les routes départementales en Sarthe is a dataset listed in data.sarthe.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de la Sarthe. Le jeu de données présente l'état des chantiers en cours sur les routes départementales (RD) en Sarthe sous la forme de tronçons de route. Coverage: Sarthe. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Routes, Chantiers routiers, datagouv. The portal shows 31 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-sarthe-fr-portal.
